name: Ukon
source:
A traveler and mercenary captain [url=/c37791]Haku[/url] and [url=/c37789]Kuon[/url] encounter in a remote Kujyuri village.
While rough around the edges and a little boisterous, he commands immense respect from his men, and is currently contracted to escort a caravan of offerings to the Imperial Capital. He is also [url=/c37792]Nekone's[/url] older brother.

[From [url=http://atlus.com/uta/deception/home.html]official site[/url]]
